blocks.text: Bean processing prepares whole pulses such as rajma, cowpea and other dry beans for retail and export sale. Unlike split dals, beans are handled whole: cleaned of stones and dust, separated by density, graded by size, polished, then optically sorted to remove discoloured and damaged seed before bagging. ART Mechatronics supplies complete bean cleaning, grading and packing lines.

blocks.title: Intake & Pre-Cleaning
desc: Dry beans are tipped into intake and carried through cleaning to remove soil, pod pieces, straw and dust.
Ferrous tramp metal picked up during harvest and transport is taken out at this stage.

blocks.title: De-stoning & Density Separation
desc: Beans sit close in size to field stones and soil clods, so this separation works on density rather than screen size alone.
Light, hollow and insect-damaged beans are lifted away in the air stream.

blocks.title: Size Grading
desc: Whole beans are traded by size grade, so the cleaned lot is split into count fractions on graded screens.
Undersized and broken beans are diverted into a separate stream.

blocks.title: Polishing & De-dusting
desc: Beans are polished to lift dust and field soil off the seed coat and give an even surface.
Dust drawn off during polishing is collected rather than released into the plant.

blocks.title: Optical Sorting & Inspection
desc: Colour sorting takes out discoloured, spotted, mouldy and off-variety beans.
Beans destined for export are then checked for stone, glass and metal before bagging.

blocks.title: Bagging & Export Packing
desc: Graded beans go into retail packs or woven sacks for bulk and export despatch.
Filled sacks are weighed, stitched, palletised and wrapped for transport.

intro: Pea processing converts dried yellow and green peas into split matar dal and pea flour. blocks.text: Pea processing converts dried yellow and green peas into split matar dal and pea flour. Peas are cleaned and de-stoned, graded by size, dried to condition the husk, then dehusked and split, with the loosened husk drawn off by aspiration. Part of the output is milled into flour. ART Mechatronics supplies complete pea milling, sorting and packing lines.

blocks.title: Intake & Cleaning
desc: Dried peas are received and cleaned of straw, chaff, dust and stones.
Magnets take out tramp iron before the peas reach the mill.

blocks.title: Grading & Drying
desc: Peas are graded into size fractions so that each can be milled on its own setting.
Drying brings the seed to a condition in which the husk parts from the kernel.

blocks.title: Dehusking & Splitting
desc: The husk is abraded off in the dehusking section and the kernel is then split into matar dal.
Loose husk is parted from the dal by winnowing before the dal moves on.

blocks.title: Husk Handling & Polishing
desc: Husk and fine powder drawn off the mill are collected for use as cattle feed instead of loading the plant air.
The split dal is polished before it goes forward to sorting.

blocks.title: Flour Milling
desc: Part of the dehusked pea is ground into pea flour for snack and blended-flour use.
The ground stock is sifted and the coarse fraction is returned to the mill.

blocks.title: Sorting & Packing
desc: Colour sorting removes discoloured and off-grade grains from the dal stream.
Dal and flour are checked for metal, then weighed, filled and coded on their own packing lines.

intro: Chickpea processing turns raw chana into chana dal, roasted gram and besan flour. The seed is cleaned, de-stoned and graded, conditioned to loosen the skin, then dehusked and split into dal. Separate routes roast the gram or grind it into besan, after which the product is sorted, weighed and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies complete chickpea processing lines.

blocks.text: Chickpea processing turns raw chana into chana dal, roasted gram and besan flour. The seed is cleaned, de-stoned and graded, conditioned to loosen the skin, then dehusked and split into dal. Separate routes roast the gram or grind it into besan, after which the product is sorted, weighed and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies complete chickpea processing lines.

blocks.title: Intake & Cleaning
desc: Raw chana is cleaned of soil, chaff, straw, stones and metal as soon as it is received.
Elevators and conveyors move the seed between cleaning stages without manual handling.

blocks.title: Grading & Conditioning
desc: Chana is graded by size and density so that dehusking can be set separately for each fraction.
The seed is then mixed with water, held, and dried under control so that the skin loosens from the cotyledons before milling.

blocks.title: Dehusking & Splitting
desc: The skin is abraded away and the kernel is split into chana dal.
Husk is drawn off by air and collected apart from the dal stream.

blocks.title: Roasting Route for Roasted Gram
desc: Part of the crop is roasted rather than milled, then cooled before the brittle skin is rubbed off.
The loosened skin is winnowed away to leave clean roasted gram.

blocks.title: Besan Milling
desc: Chana dal is ground into besan, the gram flour used throughout Indian cooking.
Ground stock is sifted and the coarse tailings are sent back for regrinding.

blocks.title: Weighing & Packing
desc: Dal and roasted gram are weighed and filled as grain, while besan, being a powder, is filled by auger into pouches and bags.
Packs are checked for metal and weight before despatch.

metaTitle: Sesame Processing Plant & Seed Hulling Machinery
metaDesc: Sesame processing plant and machinery for washing, hulling, hull separation, drying, colour sorting, oil expelling and packing. Turnkey til lines by ART Mechatronics.
intro: Sesame processing turns raw til seed into hulled sesame, roasted seed and sesame oil. Seed is cleaned and de-stoned, washed and soaked to loosen the hull, hulled and parted from the hull by density and air, then dried, cooled and colour sorted. A separate route roasts and expels the seed for oil. ART Mechatronics supplies complete sesame lines.

blocks.text: Sesame processing turns raw til seed into hulled sesame, roasted seed and sesame oil. Seed is cleaned and de-stoned, washed and soaked to loosen the hull, hulled and parted from the hull by density and air, then dried, cooled and colour sorted. A separate route roasts and expels the seed for oil. ART Mechatronics supplies complete sesame lines.

blocks.title: Intake & Cleaning
desc: Raw sesame carries a heavy load of field dust, sand and small stones, so cleaning is done in stages.
Screens, air and de-stoning bring the seed to a state fit for washing.

blocks.title: Washing & Soaking
desc: Seed is washed and then soaked so that the hull swells and lifts from the kernel.
The wet section is kept apart from the dry side of the plant to avoid carry-over of moisture.

blocks.title: Hulling & Hull Separation
desc: The softened hull is rubbed off the seed in the hulling section.
Hull and kernel are then parted on density and in an air stream, since the two are close in size.

blocks.title: Drying & Cooling
desc: Hulled sesame is dried back down from its wet state and then cooled before storage.
Moisture is checked so that the seed is stable for packing.

blocks.title: Colour Sorting & Inspection
desc: Optical sorting removes unhulled, dark and stained seed from the white hulled sesame.
Metal detection is applied before the seed is packed or sent for pressing.

blocks.title: Roasting & Oil Expelling
desc: Seed routed to oil is roasted and then pressed in an expeller to draw out til oil.
The cake left after pressing is taken off as a by-product and the oil is held in tanks.

blocks.title: Weighing & Packing
desc: Hulled sesame is weighed and packed for food use and for export despatch.
Packs may be gas flushed, as the seed is oil-rich.

h1: Soybean Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Soybean Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Soybean processing lines for cleaning, cracking, dehulling, flaking, oil expelling and soya flour milling, supplied and commissioned by ART Mechatronics.
intro: Soybean processing turns harvested beans into oil, cake and soya flour for food and feed use. Cleaned beans are cracked, dehulled, conditioned and flaked before the oil is expelled, and the residual cake is milled into meal or flour. ART Mechatronics supplies soybean cleaning, dehulling, flaking, expelling, milling and packing lines as complete turnkey plants.

blocks.text: Soybean processing turns harvested beans into oil, cake and soya flour for food and feed use. Cleaned beans are cracked, dehulled, conditioned and flaked before the oil is expelled, and the residual cake is milled into meal or flour. ART Mechatronics supplies soybean cleaning, dehulling, flaking, expelling, milling and packing lines as complete turnkey plants.

blocks.title: Cleaning & De-Stoning
desc: Incoming beans are screened to remove pods, straw, dust and undersized material, with stones and tramp metal taken out before any milling stage.
Removing hard contaminants early protects the cracking and flaking rolls further down the line.

blocks.title: Cracking & Dehulling
desc: Whole beans are cracked into pieces so the hull loosens from the cotyledon, and the light hulls are then drawn off in an air stream.
Hull removal raises the protein level of the meal and keeps fibre out of the oil-bearing fraction.

blocks.title: Conditioning & Flaking
desc: Cracked meats are warmed and moisture-conditioned so they become plastic, then passed through smooth rolls to form thin flakes.
Flaking opens up the cell structure so the oil can be released in the pressing stage.

blocks.title: Extrusion & Oil Expelling
desc: Flakes are extruded and then pressed in a screw expeller, which separates crude oil from the solid cake.
Extrusion is also used on its own where full-fat soya is being produced for feed.

blocks.title: Cake Milling & Sifting
desc: Press cake is broken down and milled into soya meal or finer soya flour, then classified to the grade being sold.
Milling releases fine dust, so the mill is worked with extraction on the discharge points.

blocks.title: Weighing, Packing & Dispatch
desc: Meal, flour and whole beans are weighed and filled into bags or sacks, closed, and checked for metal before palletising.
Packed loads are wrapped for storage and transport.

metaTitle: Sunflower Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Sunflower seed processing lines for cleaning, drying, dehulling, hull separation, kernel grading, oil pressing and packing, supplied by ART Mechatronics.
intro: Sunflower processing separates the seed from its hull and prepares kernels for oil pressing or for confectionery packing. Seed is cleaned, dried, dehulled and the light hulls aspirated away, after which kernels are graded, flaked and pressed. ART Mechatronics supplies sunflower cleaning, drying, dehulling, hull separation, pressing and packing lines as complete plants.

blocks.text: Sunflower processing separates the seed from its hull and prepares kernels for oil pressing or for confectionery packing. Seed is cleaned, dried, dehulled and the light hulls aspirated away, after which kernels are graded, flaked and pressed. ART Mechatronics supplies sunflower cleaning, drying, dehulling, hull separation, pressing and packing lines as complete plants.

blocks.title: Cleaning & Pre-Grading
desc: Seed arriving from the field is screened free of stalk, husk fragments, dust and field soil, and separated by size before dehulling.
Even sizing at this point makes the dehuller easier to set.

blocks.title: Drying & Conditioning
desc: Seed is dried down and held until the moisture is even through the lot, which is what makes the hull brittle enough to crack cleanly.
Moisture is checked on samples before the seed is released to the dehuller.

blocks.title: Dehulling & Hull Separation
desc: Seed is impacted to split the hull from the kernel, and the two are then parted by air because the hull is much lighter.
Unhulled seed returned by the separator is recirculated for a second pass.

blocks.title: Kernel Grading & Sorting
desc: Kernels are graded by size and density, and discoloured kernels, remaining hull and foreign matter are picked out optically.
This stage decides which kernels go to the food line and which go for crushing.

blocks.title: Flaking & Oil Expelling
desc: Kernels for oil are flaked between rolls and then pressed in a screw expeller to draw off crude sunflower oil.
The cake leaving the press is cooled before it goes to storage or milling.

blocks.title: Kernel Weighing & Packing
desc: Food-grade kernels are weighed and filled into pouches, with gas flushing used where a longer shelf life is wanted.
Filled packs pass a metal check and a weight check before they are cased.

h1: Canola Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Canola Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Canola and rapeseed processing lines for cleaning, drying, seed conditioning, flaking, pressing, oil clarification and packing, built by ART Mechatronics.
intro: Canola processing prepares small rapeseed-type oilseeds for pressing without dehulling. Seed is cleaned on fine screens, dried and stored, then conditioned with heat, flaked and pressed, leaving crude oil for clarification and a press cake for meal. ART Mechatronics supplies canola cleaning, drying, conditioning, flaking, pressing, oil handling and packing lines as complete plants.

blocks.text: Canola processing prepares small rapeseed-type oilseeds for pressing without dehulling. Seed is cleaned on fine screens, dried and stored, then conditioned with heat, flaked and pressed, leaving crude oil for clarification and a press cake for meal. ART Mechatronics supplies canola cleaning, drying, conditioning, flaking, pressing, oil handling and packing lines as complete plants.

blocks.title: Cleaning & Fine Screening
desc: Canola seed is small and round, so it is cleaned on graded screens where pods, stalk and chaff are scalped off the upper deck and sand and fines drop through the lower deck.
Tramp metal and stones are taken out before the seed enters storage.

blocks.title: Drying & Storage
desc: Seed is dried and then held in silos and day bins that feed the press house at a steady rate.
Storing seed dry keeps it stable and stops heating in the bin.

blocks.title: Seed Conditioning
desc: Unlike sunflower or soybean, canola is not dehulled; the whole seed is warmed before flaking so the seed coat does not shatter on the rolls.
Conditioning is done with indirect heat in jacketed vessels fed by the plant steam supply.

blocks.title: Flaking, Cooking & Pressing
desc: Conditioned seed is flaked between rolls, and the flakes are then cooked so the oil-bearing cells break down before pressing in a screw expeller, commonly as a pre-press followed by a full press.
Crude oil runs off to the clarification tanks and the cake is carried away for meal handling.

blocks.title: Oil Clarification & Storage
desc: Crude oil carries fine solids from the press, which are separated out before the oil is held in tanks.
Clarified oil is stored ready for filling or for onward refining.

blocks.title: Oil Filling & Meal Packing
desc: Oil is filled into bottles, capped and labelled, while the press cake is broken down and bagged as canola meal.
Both streams are packed on the same site so oil and meal leave together.

metaTitle: Olive Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Olive processing lines for washing, crushing, malaxation, oil separation, storage, bottling and table-olive pitting and packing, built by ART Mechatronics.
intro: Olive processing handles a fresh fruit rather than a dry seed. Olives are received, de-leafed and washed, crushed to a paste, slowly malaxed so the oil droplets join together, and the oil is then separated from water and pomace. ART Mechatronics supplies olive washing, crushing, malaxation, separation, storage, bottling and table-olive packing lines.

blocks.text: Olive processing handles a fresh fruit rather than a dry seed. Olives are received, de-leafed and washed, crushed to a paste, slowly malaxed so the oil droplets join together, and the oil is then separated from water and pomace. ART Mechatronics supplies olive washing, crushing, malaxation, separation, storage, bottling and table-olive packing lines.

blocks.title: Reception, Leaf Removal & Washing
desc: Fruit is tipped from the field crates, leaves and twigs are blown off, and the olives are washed and rinsed to take away soil and spray residue.
Because olives arrive wet and bruise easily, they are moved on conveyors and taken into the mill soon after reception.

blocks.title: Crushing to Paste
desc: Washed olives, stone included, are crushed into a paste so the oil is released from the fruit cells.
The paste is then carried straight on to mixing without being held.

blocks.title: Malaxation
desc: The paste is stirred slowly in jacketed vessels so the small oil droplets meet and join into a separable phase.
Warm water circulating in the jacket keeps the paste at an even working temperature throughout the batch.

blocks.title: Oil Separation
desc: The malaxed paste is separated into oil, vegetation water and pomace, and the oil is then polished to take out the last solids.
Pomace is conveyed away for drying or disposal as a by-product.

blocks.title: Storage & Bottling
desc: Oil is settled and held in closed tanks away from light and air, then filled into bottles, capped and labelled.
Filling and closing run in line so the oil spends little time exposed.

blocks.title: Table Olive Curing, Pitting & Packing
desc: Olives intended for the table are cured in brine in tanks, then graded and pitted before filling into jars or cans.
Closed containers are labelled to the pack and grade being run.

metaDesc: Plant and machinery for white bread and buns: flour handling, dough mixing, moulding, proving, baking, cooling, slicing and packing lines from ART Mechatronics.
intro: White bread and bun production begins with refined wheat flour, water, yeast, salt and fat, mixed into a dough that is divided, moulded, proved and baked. Loaves are depanned, cooled, sliced and bagged, while buns are cooled and packed whole. ART Mechatronics builds the line as one system, from flour intake through to sealed, coded packs.

blocks.text: White bread and bun production begins with refined wheat flour, water, yeast, salt and fat, mixed into a dough that is divided, moulded, proved and baked. Loaves are depanned, cooled, sliced and bagged, while buns are cooled and packed whole. ART Mechatronics builds the line as one system, from flour intake through to sealed, coded packs.

blocks.title: Flour Intake & Sifting
desc: Refined wheat flour arrives in bags or in bulk and is emptied, conveyed and held in storage until it is called to the mixer.
Sifting and magnetic separation take out lumps and any stray ferrous metal before the flour enters the dough.

blocks.title: Dough Mixing
desc: Flour, water, yeast, salt, sugar and fat are weighed and mixed until the gluten is developed and the dough is smooth.
Mixing water is chilled, so that the heat generated by mixing does not push the dough temperature past what the recipe allows.

blocks.title: Dividing, Rounding & Moulding
desc: Bulk dough is cut into equal pieces, rounded, rested and moulded, then dropped into tins for loaves or set out in rows for buns.
Consistent piece weight here is what keeps the finished loaves and buns uniform through the rest of the line.

blocks.title: Proving & Baking
desc: Shaped dough is held in a warm, humid chamber so the yeast can raise it, then baked until the crust colours and the crumb sets.
Steam and air handling hold the humidity in the prover, while the oven and its burner supply the baking heat.

blocks.title: Depanning, Cooling & Slicing
desc: Baked loaves are turned out of their tins and carried through cooling conveyors until the crumb is firm enough to cut cleanly.
Cooled loaves are sliced; buns are normally packed whole, or cut only where a burger or sandwich bun is called for.

blocks.title: Packing, Coding & Inspection
desc: Sliced loaves and buns are wrapped, date coded, weight checked and screened for stray metal before they leave the line.
Finished packs are then collated into cartons for distribution.

h1: Brown & Multi Grain Bread Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Brown & Multi Grain Bread Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Plant and machinery for brown and multi grain bread: grain cleaning, milling, soaking, dough mixing, baking, slicing and packing lines from ART Mechatronics.
intro: Brown and multi grain bread is made from wholemeal flour, bran and a blend of cleaned grains and seeds, which are milled or cracked and usually soaked before they enter the dough. The dough is mixed, moulded, seeded, proved and baked, then cooled, sliced and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies the line from grain cleaning to sealed packs.

blocks.text: Brown and multi grain bread is made from wholemeal flour, bran and a blend of cleaned grains and seeds, which are milled or cracked and usually soaked before they enter the dough. The dough is mixed, moulded, seeded, proved and baked, then cooled, sliced and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies the line from grain cleaning to sealed packs.

blocks.title: Grain & Seed Cleaning
desc: Wheat, the other grains and the seeds used for inclusion and topping are cleaned of dust, chaff, stones, light matter and discoloured kernels.
Cleaning at intake protects the mill rolls and keeps foreign matter out of the finished loaf.

blocks.title: Milling, Cracking & Roasting
desc: Grain is milled to wholemeal flour, or cracked coarser where visible pieces are wanted in the crumb, and the fractions are separated by sifting.
Seeds are roasted where the recipe calls for a toasted flavour rather than a raw one.

blocks.title: Blending & Soaking
desc: Wholemeal flour, bran, cracked grain and seeds are weighed and dry blended into a consistent premix.
Coarse grain and seed are then soaked in water, so that they do not draw moisture out of the dough during mixing and proving.

blocks.title: Dough Mixing
desc: The dry premix and the soaked grain are combined with water, yeast, salt and improver and mixed into a dough.
Bran and grain particles cut the gluten network, so these doughs are mixed and handled more gently than a white dough.

blocks.title: Moulding, Seeding & Proving
desc: Dough is divided, moulded and placed into tins or onto trays, and the damp top is dressed with oats, seeds or cracked grain.
The shaped dough then proves in a warm, humid chamber before it is sent to the oven.

blocks.title: Baking & Cooling
desc: Loaves are baked until the crust colours and the crumb is set, then cooled before they can be cut.
Cooling is taken far enough that the softer wholemeal crumb slices cleanly instead of tearing.

blocks.title: Slicing, Packing & Coding
desc: Cooled loaves are sliced and packed, with batch and date details printed on each pack.
Packs pass metal detection before cases are made up for dispatch.

h1: Curd Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Curd Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Curd Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Complete curd processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging, engineered as one turnkey line.
intro: Curd processing sets pasteurised milk with a lactic starter culture until it thickens into dahi. Milk is standardised, homogenised, heat treated and cooled before the culture is added, and the inoculated milk is filled into cups or pouches and held warm until it sets. ART Mechatronics supplies curd plant equipment from milk reception through incubation, chilling and packing.

blocks.text: Curd processing sets pasteurised milk with a lactic starter culture until it thickens into dahi. Milk is standardised, homogenised, heat treated and cooled before the culture is added, and the inoculated milk is filled into cups or pouches and held warm until it sets. ART Mechatronics supplies curd plant equipment from milk reception through incubation, chilling and packing.

blocks.title: Milk Reception & Chilling
desc: Raw milk is received, weighed, clarified and chilled into storage tanks.
Holding the milk cold before the batch begins keeps the acidity stable and protects the set.

blocks.title: Standardisation & Homogenisation
desc: Fat and milk solids are adjusted to the recipe, and the milk is homogenised so the fat stays evenly dispersed.
Without homogenisation a cream layer forms on top of the set curd.

blocks.title: Heat Treatment & Cooling
desc: The standardised milk is heat treated to reduce spoilage organisms and to denature the whey proteins that give curd its firmness.
It is then cooled to the temperature at which the starter culture is added.

blocks.title: Inoculation & Cup Filling
desc: Starter culture is dosed into the cooled milk under gentle agitation.
Because curd is set in its own container, the inoculated milk is filled into cups, tubs or pouches and sealed before it begins to gel.

blocks.title: Incubation & Setting
desc: Filled and sealed packs are moved into a warm incubation room and left undisturbed until the curd sets firm and the acidity is reached.
Any vibration during this stage breaks the gel and causes whey to separate.

blocks.title: Chilling, Coding & Despatch
desc: Set packs are transferred to cold storage, which slows the culture and holds the texture.
Packs are then date coded, weight checked and crated for cold-chain despatch.

h1: Yogurt Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Yogurt Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Yogurt Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Complete yogurt processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging, engineered as one turnkey line.
intro: Yogurt processing ferments standardised milk with defined starter cultures to produce a set or stirred cultured product. Milk is blended with milk solids and stabilisers, homogenised, heat treated, cooled and inoculated, then fermented until the required acidity develops before fruit or flavour is added. ART Mechatronics supplies yogurt plant equipment covering blending, fermentation, cooling, dosing and filling.

blocks.text: Yogurt processing ferments standardised milk with defined starter cultures to produce a set or stirred cultured product. Milk is blended with milk solids and stabilisers, homogenised, heat treated, cooled and inoculated, then fermented until the required acidity develops before fruit or flavour is added. ART Mechatronics supplies yogurt plant equipment covering blending, fermentation, cooling, dosing and filling.

blocks.title: Mix Preparation & Dry Blending
desc: Skim milk powder, stabilisers and sugar are dispersed into the milk base and agitated until fully hydrated.
This dry-blending stage is what separates yogurt from plain curd, since the added solids build body and control whey separation.

blocks.title: Homogenisation & Heat Treatment
desc: The mix is homogenised to give a smooth, uniform body and then heat treated.
It is cooled to the inoculation temperature before the cultures go in.

blocks.title: Fermentation
desc: Starter cultures are added and the mix is held in insulated, jacketed fermentation tanks until the acidity develops.
The batch is then cooled to slow the culture and fix the flavour profile.

blocks.title: Stirring & Fruit Dosing
desc: For stirred yogurt the coagulum is broken gently so it flows without turning thin.
Fruit preparation, pulp or flavour is metered in ahead of the filler.

blocks.title: Filling & Sealing
desc: The product is filled into preformed cups, bottles or thermoformed packs and sealed with foil or film.
Set yogurt is filled before fermentation, stirred yogurt after it.

blocks.title: Cold Storage & Secondary Packing
desc: Packs are chilled, date coded and weight checked.
They are then collated into cartons and shippers for cold-chain distribution.

h1: Ghee Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Ghee Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Ghee Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Complete ghee processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging, engineered as one turnkey line.
intro: Ghee processing clarifies butter or cream by heating it until the water evaporates and the milk solids separate, leaving clear butterfat. The browned residue is settled and removed, the fat is filtered, then cooled so that it granulates before filling into jars, tins or pouches. ART Mechatronics supplies ghee plant equipment for melting, clarification, separation, cooling and packing.

blocks.text: Ghee processing clarifies butter or cream by heating it until the water evaporates and the milk solids separate, leaving clear butterfat. The browned residue is settled and removed, the fat is filtered, then cooled so that it granulates before filling into jars, tins or pouches. ART Mechatronics supplies ghee plant equipment for melting, clarification, separation, cooling and packing.

blocks.title: Cream or Butter Preparation
desc: Cream is separated from milk, or stored white butter is drawn from cold storage and broken down for feeding.
The choice of feedstock decides the flavour route the plant follows.

blocks.title: Melting & Clarification
desc: The fat is melted and boiled in a steam-jacketed kettle so the moisture evaporates and the milk solids brown and drop out.
This browning stage is what gives ghee its characteristic aroma.

blocks.title: Residue Settling & Filtration
desc: The settled residue is drawn off the bottom and the clear fat is passed through sieves and a separator to remove fines.
Residue left in the fat shortens shelf life.

blocks.title: Cooling & Granulation
desc: The clarified fat is cooled under controlled conditions so that the fat crystals form.
The cooling profile decides whether the finished ghee is grainy or smooth.

blocks.title: Filling & Sealing
desc: Ghee is filled into jars, tins, pouches and bulk containers, then sealed or capped.
Fill formats range from small retail packs to institutional tins.

blocks.title: Coding, Inspection & Cartoning
desc: Filled packs are date coded, weight checked and screened for foreign metal.
They are then labelled and packed into master cartons for despatch.

h1: Paneer Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Paneer Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Paneer Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Complete paneer processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging, engineered as one turnkey line.
intro: Paneer processing coagulates hot standardised milk with a food acid, then separates the curd from the whey. The curd is drained, pressed into blocks, chilled in cold water, cut to size and vacuum packed or frozen. Unlike cheese, paneer uses no starter culture or rennet and is not ripened. ART Mechatronics supplies paneer plant equipment from milk handling to block packing.

blocks.text: Paneer processing coagulates hot standardised milk with a food acid, then separates the curd from the whey. The curd is drained, pressed into blocks, chilled in cold water, cut to size and vacuum packed or frozen. Unlike cheese, paneer uses no starter culture or rennet and is not ripened. ART Mechatronics supplies paneer plant equipment from milk handling to block packing.

blocks.title: Milk Reception & Standardisation
desc: Milk is received, clarified, chilled and standardised to the fat and solids level the paneer recipe calls for.
Standardisation governs both the yield and the firmness of the finished block.

blocks.title: Heating & Acid Coagulation
desc: The standardised milk is heated and a measured food acid is dosed in under gentle stirring until the casein coagulates and the whey runs clear.
This direct acid coagulation is the step that distinguishes paneer from cultured cheeses.

blocks.title: Whey Drainage & Pressing
desc: Whey is drained off and collected, and the curd is filled into hoops and pressed until the block firms up.
Pressing expels the remaining moisture and knits the curd into a sliceable body.

blocks.title: Chilling & Cutting
desc: Pressed blocks are chilled in cold water so that the fat sets and the block holds its shape.
They are then cut into retail blocks, cubes or slices.

blocks.title: Vacuum Packing & Freezing
desc: Blocks and cubes are vacuum packed or tray sealed to keep them firm and free of surface drying.
Frozen paneer lines add an individual freezing stage before bagging.

blocks.title: Coding & Cold Despatch
desc: Packs are date coded, weight checked and cartoned.
Finished stock is held in cold storage until despatch on the cold chain.

h1: Cheese Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Cheese Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Cheese Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Complete cheese processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging, engineered as one turnkey line.
intro: Cheese processing coagulates pasteurised milk with starter culture and rennet, then cuts, cooks and drains the curd. The curd is moulded and pressed, salted or brined, and ripened in temperature-controlled rooms before being cut, sliced or shredded and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies cheese plant equipment covering milk treatment, curd handling, pressing, ripening storage and packing.

blocks.text: Cheese processing coagulates pasteurised milk with starter culture and rennet, then cuts, cooks and drains the curd. The curd is moulded and pressed, salted or brined, and ripened in temperature-controlled rooms before being cut, sliced or shredded and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies cheese plant equipment covering milk treatment, curd handling, pressing, ripening storage and packing.

blocks.title: Milk Treatment & Pasteurisation
desc: Milk is clarified, standardised for both fat and protein, and pasteurised before it reaches the cheese vat.
The protein-to-fat ratio set here governs the yield and the final texture.

blocks.title: Culture, Rennet & Coagulation
desc: Starter culture and rennet are dosed into the vat and stirred in briefly, after which the milk is left still until a firm coagulum forms.
Rennet coagulation, rather than acid alone, is what allows cheese to be ripened later.

blocks.title: Curd Cutting & Cooking
desc: The coagulum is cut into grains and then stirred and warmed so the grains contract and expel whey.
Grain size and cooking decide how much moisture stays in the cheese.

blocks.title: Whey Draining, Moulding & Pressing
desc: Whey is drawn off and collected, and the curd is filled into moulds.
Pressing knits the grains into a closed block and drives out the last of the free whey.

blocks.title: Salting & Ripening
desc: Blocks are dry salted or held in brine, then moved to ripening rooms where humidity and temperature are controlled.
Flavour and body develop over the ripening period, which varies by cheese variety.

blocks.title: Cutting, Slicing & Shredding
desc: Ripened blocks are cut down to portion size.
Depending on the product they are then sliced, diced or shredded for retail and food-service packs.

blocks.title: Packing & Inspection
desc: Portions are vacuum packed, flow wrapped or gas flushed in trays to hold the cheese without surface mould.
Packs are then screened for foreign metal and packed into master cartons.

h1: Lassi Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Lassi Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Lassi Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Complete lassi processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging, engineered as one turnkey line.
intro: Lassi processing blends set curd with water, sugar and flavouring into a drinkable cultured beverage. Sugar syrup is prepared and filtered, the curd base is broken down and mixed to the recipe, and the blend is homogenised, heat treated and chilled before filling into bottles, cups or pouches. ART Mechatronics supplies lassi plant equipment for syrup preparation, blending, heat treatment, chilling and filling.

blocks.text: Lassi processing blends set curd with water, sugar and flavouring into a drinkable cultured beverage. Sugar syrup is prepared and filtered, the curd base is broken down and mixed to the recipe, and the blend is homogenised, heat treated and chilled before filling into bottles, cups or pouches. ART Mechatronics supplies lassi plant equipment for syrup preparation, blending, heat treatment, chilling and filling.

blocks.title: Curd Base Preparation
desc: Set curd is produced in house or drawn from chilled storage and broken down into a smooth, pumpable base.
The acidity of this base sets the taste profile of the finished drink.

blocks.title: Sugar Syrup Preparation & Filtration
desc: Sugar is dissolved in water, boiled and passed through a sieve so no undissolved crystals or bag fibres reach the blend.
Sweet lassi lines run this stage continuously alongside the curd base.

blocks.title: Blending & Standardisation
desc: Curd base, syrup, water, salt or fruit pulp are metered into the blend tank and mixed to the recipe.
Recipe control at this stage is what keeps batch-to-batch taste consistent.

blocks.title: Homogenisation & Heat Treatment
desc: The blend is homogenised so the drink pours evenly and does not separate in the bottle, then heat treated.
Ambient shelf-stable lassi runs a sterilisation step in place of simple chilling.

blocks.title: Chilling & Filling
desc: The drink is chilled and filled into rinsed bottles, cups or pouches.
Bottle lines rinse, fill and cap in sequence, while pouch lines form, fill and seal from film.

blocks.title: Labelling, Coding & Crating
desc: Filled packs are labelled, date coded and checked for leaks.
They are then shrink sleeved or crated and moved onto the cold chain.

h1: Plant Based Food Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Plant Based Food Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Plant based food processing plant and machinery for textured protein, patties and nuggets — dry blending, extrusion, forming, frying, freezing and packing lines.
intro: Plant based food processing converts soya, pulses, wheat and other plant proteins into textured meat alternatives such as chunks, granules, patties and nuggets. Dry protein blends are hydrated and extruded to build a fibre-like texture, then formed, coated, cooked, frozen and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies the mixing, extrusion, forming, freezing and packaging systems used on these lines.

blocks.text: Plant based food processing converts soya, pulses, wheat and other plant proteins into textured meat alternatives such as chunks, granules, patties and nuggets. Dry protein blends are hydrated and extruded to build a fibre-like texture, then formed, coated, cooked, frozen and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies the mixing, extrusion, forming, freezing and packaging systems used on these lines.

sections.title: Complete Plant Based Food Process Flow
sections.key: COMPLETE PLANT BASED FOOD PROCESS FLOW

blocks.title: Raw Material Intake & Dry Blending
desc: Protein flours, starches and dry ingredients are tipped, screened for metal and weighed out to recipe.
They are blended into a uniform base mix, since an even dry blend decides how the protein later texturises.

blocks.title: Hydration & Extrusion
desc: The blend is hydrated and passed through an extruder, where heat and shear align the protein into a fibrous structure.
This texturising step is what gives plant based products their meat-like bite.

blocks.title: Forming & Coating
desc: Textured protein is combined with binders, fats and flavours, then formed into patties, strips or nuggets.
Products meant to be fried are coated with batter and breading at this stage.

blocks.title: Frying, Cooking & Freezing
desc: Formed pieces are fried or cooked to set the surface and colour, then cooled.
They are frozen individually so the pieces stay loose and separate inside the pack.

blocks.title: Packing & Inspection
desc: Frozen pieces are weighed, filled into pouches or trays and sealed.
Each pack is checked for foreign matter and correct weight before cartoning.

h1: Packed Food Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Packed Food Packaging Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Packed food lines for snacks, flours, spices and mixes — feeding, multihead weighing, form fill seal, coding, metal detection, cartoning and palletising.
intro: Packed food processing covers the weighing, filling, sealing and secondary packing of finished foods such as snacks, flours, spices, dry mixes and confectionery into retail and bulk packs. The pack protects the product from moisture, air and contamination and carries batch and date information. ART Mechatronics supplies weighing, form fill seal, coding, inspection and end-of-line packaging systems.

blocks.text: Packed food processing covers the weighing, filling, sealing and secondary packing of finished foods such as snacks, flours, spices, dry mixes and confectionery into retail and bulk packs. The pack protects the product from moisture, air and contamination and carries batch and date information. ART Mechatronics supplies weighing, form fill seal, coding, inspection and end-of-line packaging systems.

blocks.title: Product Feeding & Buffering
desc: Finished product is elevated from the process area and held in a buffer hopper above the packing machine.
Steady feeding keeps the filling heads supplied without the product being handled roughly.

blocks.title: Weighing & Dosing
desc: Each pack is dosed by weight for granular and piece products, or by volume for free-flowing powders.
Accurate dosing controls give-away and keeps declared pack contents consistent.

blocks.title: Filling & Sealing
desc: Film is formed into a pouch, filled and sealed, or a premade pouch or pack is filled and closed.
Products that need protection from oxidation are gas-flushed before the seal is made.

blocks.title: Coding & Inspection
desc: Batch number, date and pack details are printed on every pack.
Packs then pass foreign-body and weight checks, and any that fail are rejected off the line.

blocks.title: Secondary & End-of-Line Packing
desc: Sealed packs are labelled, collated into cartons and cases, then stacked onto pallets.
Wrapping holds the load together for storage and transport.

h1: Frozen Food Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Frozen Food Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Frozen food plant and machinery for vegetables, potatoes, fruit and snacks — washing, peeling, cutting, blanching, IQF and blast freezing, cold storage and packing.
intro: Frozen food processing takes fresh vegetables, potatoes, fruit and prepared snacks and freezes them so they can be stored and moved on the cold chain until they are cooked. Produce is washed, peeled, cut, blanched, cooled and frozen, then packed and held in cold storage. ART Mechatronics supplies washing, cutting, blanching, freezing, cold storage and packing systems for frozen food plants.

blocks.text: Frozen food processing takes fresh vegetables, potatoes, fruit and prepared snacks and freezes them so they can be stored and moved on the cold chain until they are cooked. Produce is washed, peeled, cut, blanched, cooled and frozen, then packed and held in cold storage. ART Mechatronics supplies washing, cutting, blanching, freezing, cold storage and packing systems for frozen food plants.

blocks.title: Washing, Sorting & Grading
desc: Incoming produce is washed to remove field soil, then sorted to take out stones, damaged pieces and off-colour material.
Grading separates the crop by size so that later cutting and freezing behave predictably.

blocks.title: Peeling & Cutting
desc: Skins are removed where the product calls for it, and the produce is cut to the finished shape — dice, slices, strips or florets.
Cut size is what decides how the pieces freeze and how they cook later.

blocks.title: Blanching & Cooling
desc: Cut produce is blanched in hot water or steam to stop enzyme activity that would otherwise dull colour and flavour in storage.
It is then cooled quickly so the pieces do not carry on cooking.

blocks.title: Freezing
desc: Pieces are frozen individually on a fluidised or belt freezer so they remain free-flowing, while blocks and packed formats go to a blast freezer.
Frozen product is moved into cold rooms held at frozen storage conditions.

blocks.title: Packing & Cold Dispatch
desc: Frozen product is weighed, filled into pouches, bags or trays and sealed.
Packs are coded, checked and palletised for cold-chain dispatch.

h1: Instant Food Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Instant Food Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Instant food plant and machinery for noodles, soups and instant mixes — grain cleaning, milling, cooking, drying, seasoning blending and sachet or cup packing.
intro: Instant food processing produces noodles, soups, porridge and savoury mixes that need only hot water before eating. Grains and pulses are cleaned and milled, cooked or extruded, dried down to a storage-stable moisture, then blended with seasoning and filled into sachets or cups. ART Mechatronics supplies milling, cooking, drying, blending and sachet packing systems for instant food plants.

blocks.text: Instant food processing produces noodles, soups, porridge and savoury mixes that need only hot water before eating. Grains and pulses are cleaned and milled, cooked or extruded, dried down to a storage-stable moisture, then blended with seasoning and filled into sachets or cups. ART Mechatronics supplies milling, cooking, drying, blending and sachet packing systems for instant food plants.

blocks.title: Grain Cleaning & Milling
desc: Grains and pulses are cleaned of dust, chaff, stones and tramp metal before they reach the mill.
They are then milled and sifted to the flour or semolina grade the recipe needs.

blocks.title: Cooking, Extrusion & Shaping
desc: Flour is hydrated and cooked or extruded so the starch gelatinises, which is what lets the finished product rehydrate in hot water.
The cooked mass is shaped into noodle strands, flakes or granules.

blocks.title: Drying
desc: The shaped noodle cake or granule is dried, either by frying or by hot air, until it is stable for storage without refrigeration.
Liquid bases for soups and gravies are dried separately into powder.

blocks.title: Seasoning & Blend Preparation
desc: Spices, dehydrated vegetables, salt and flavour powders are ground to a common particle size and blended into the seasoning mix.
The blend is sieved and checked before it goes to filling.

blocks.title: Sachet & Cup Filling
desc: Seasoning is filled into small sachets on multi-lane machines, while the noodle cake or mix is filled into pouches or cups.
Sachets and the main product are brought together in the same outer pack.

blocks.title: Coding, Inspection & Cartoning
desc: Every pack is coded and passed through weight and foreign-body checks.
Packs are then collated into cartons and cases for dispatch.

h1: Ready To Eat Food Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Ready To Eat Food Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Ready to eat food plant and machinery for curries, dals and rice meals — vegetable prep, kettle cooking, pouch and tray filling, retort sterilisation and cartoning.
intro: Ready to eat food processing turns cooked curries, dals, rice dishes and vegetable preparations into shelf-stable packs that need only reheating. Ingredients are prepared and cooked, filled hot into pouches or trays, sealed, then sterilised in a retort and cooled before packing. ART Mechatronics supplies preparation, cooking, filling, sealing, retort sterilisation and cartoning systems for ready to eat lines.

blocks.text: Ready to eat food processing turns cooked curries, dals, rice dishes and vegetable preparations into shelf-stable packs that need only reheating. Ingredients are prepared and cooked, filled hot into pouches or trays, sealed, then sterilised in a retort and cooled before packing. ART Mechatronics supplies preparation, cooking, filling, sealing, retort sterilisation and cartoning systems for ready to eat lines.

sections.title: Complete Ready To Eat Process Flow
sections.key: COMPLETE READY TO EAT PROCESS FLOW

blocks.title: Vegetable & Ingredient Preparation
desc: Vegetables are washed, peeled and cut to the size the recipe calls for.
Pieces are kept uniform so that everything in the pack cooks evenly.

blocks.title: Gravy & Base Preparation
desc: Onion, tomato and spice bases are ground into a smooth gravy and held in jacketed tanks under gentle agitation.
A consistent base is what keeps taste the same from batch to batch.

blocks.title: Cooking
desc: Prepared vegetables, pulses or rice are cooked with the gravy in steam-jacketed kettles.
The cooked recipe is held hot until it is filled, so the pack is closed on hot product.

blocks.title: Filling & Sealing
desc: Measured portions are filled into retort pouches or trays and sealed.
Seal quality is what the sterilisation stage depends on, so seals are checked as they are made.

blocks.title: Retort Sterilisation & Cooling
desc: Sealed packs are sterilised in a retort so the food keeps without refrigeration, or pasteurised where the pack is sold chilled.
Packs are then cooled and surface-dried before they are handled further.

blocks.title: Leak Testing, Coding & Cartoning
desc: Each pack is leak-tested and inspected, since a failed seal is the main risk in retort products.
Passed packs are labelled, coded and cased for dispatch.

intro: Canned fruits, vegetables and pickle processing preserves seasonal produce in brine, syrup, oil or vinegar inside sealed cans, jars and bottles. Produce is washed, sorted, peeled, de-seeded and cut, blanched where the recipe needs it, filled with the prepared liquid, seamed or capped, then pasteurised and labelled. ART Mechatronics supplies preparation, filling, seaming, pasteurising and labelling systems.

blocks.text: Canned fruits, vegetables and pickle processing preserves seasonal produce in brine, syrup, oil or vinegar inside sealed cans, jars and bottles. Produce is washed, sorted, peeled, de-seeded and cut, blanched where the recipe needs it, filled with the prepared liquid, seamed or capped, then pasteurised and labelled. sections.title: Complete Canned Fruits, Vegetables Pickle Process Flow
sections.key: COMPLETE CANNED FRUITS, VEGETABLES PICKLE PROCESS FLOW

blocks.title: Washing, Sorting & Grading
desc: Fruit and vegetables are washed and rinsed, then sorted to remove bruised, discoloured and undersized pieces.
Grading by size matters because pack appearance is judged through the glass or on opening.

blocks.title: Peeling, De-seeding & Cutting
desc: Skins, stones, seeds and stems are removed depending on the fruit or vegetable being packed.
The produce is then cut into halves, slices, cubes or spears to suit the pack format.

blocks.title: Blanching & Brine, Syrup or Masala Preparation
desc: Vegetables are blanched to soften them and set their colour before filling.
In parallel, brine, sugar syrup or the oil and spice mix for pickle is prepared and held in jacketed tanks.

blocks.title: Filling & Sealing
desc: Solids are filled into cans, jars or bottles and topped up with the hot liquid.
Cans are seamed and jars and bottles are capped to make an airtight closure.

blocks.title: Pasteurising & Cooling
desc: Sealed containers are pasteurised or sterilised where the recipe calls for it, while oil and salt preserved pickles are closed without heat treatment.
They are then cooled and dried before labels are applied.

blocks.title: Labelling & Case Packing
desc: Cans and jars are labelled and coded with batch and date details.
Containers are then packed into cases and palletised for dispatch.

h1: Food Batter Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Food Batter & Coating Mix Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Food batter plant and machinery for dry coating premixes and wet idli, dosa batter — grain cleaning, milling, wet grinding, blending, filling and chilled holding.
intro: Food batter processing produces the dry coating and breading mixes used on snacks, fritters and nuggets, and the wet fermented rice and pulse batters sold for idli and dosa. Grains and pulses are cleaned, then milled dry or wet ground, blended with starches, salt and spices, and filled. ART Mechatronics supplies cleaning, milling, wet grinding, blending and filling systems.

blocks.text: Food batter processing produces the dry coating and breading mixes used on snacks, fritters and nuggets, and the wet fermented rice and pulse batters sold for idli and dosa. Grains and pulses are cleaned, then milled dry or wet ground, blended with starches, salt and spices, and filled. ART Mechatronics supplies cleaning, milling, wet grinding, blending and filling systems.

blocks.title: Grain & Pulse Cleaning
desc: Rice, urad dal, maize and wheat are cleaned of husk, dust, stones and tramp metal.
Clean intake protects the mill and keeps grit out of the finished batter.

blocks.title: Dry Milling & Sifting
desc: For dry batter and breading premixes, cleaned grain is milled into flour and sifted to separate the coarse fraction.
Particle size is what controls how the batter picks up and clings to the product.

blocks.title: Soaking, Wet Grinding & Fermentation
desc: For wet batter, soaked rice and dal are wet ground into a smooth slurry.
The slurry is held in tanks to ferment, which is what develops the sour flavour and the rise.

blocks.title: Weighing & Blending
desc: Flours, starches, leavening, salt and spices are weighed to recipe and blended into a uniform mix.
The blend is passed over a sieve and a metal check before filling.

blocks.title: Filling & Packing
desc: Dry premix is filled by auger into pouches, bags or sacks; wet batter is filled by volume into pouches or jars.
Filled packs are weight-checked and coded.

blocks.title: Chilled Holding & Dispatch
desc: Wet fermented batter is chilled and held cold, because fermentation carries on at room temperature.
Packs are moved through a cold room and dispatched on the cold chain.

h1: Food Ingredient Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Food Ingredient Processing Plant & Machinery | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Food ingredient plant and machinery for flours, starches, powders and blends — cleaning, drying, pulverising with dust control, classifying, blending and bulk packing.
intro: Food ingredient processing produces the flours, starches, powders, granules and blends that other food factories buy as inputs, including spice powders, protein flours, bakery premixes, thickeners and seasoning blends. Material is cleaned, dried, size-reduced under dust control, classified, blended and packed in bags, sacks or drums. ART Mechatronics supplies drying, milling, sieving, blending and bulk packing systems.

blocks.text: Food ingredient processing produces the flours, starches, powders, granules and blends that other food factories buy as inputs, including spice powders, protein flours, bakery premixes, thickeners and seasoning blends. Material is cleaned, dried, size-reduced under dust control, classified, blended and packed in bags, sacks or drums. ART Mechatronics supplies drying, milling, sieving, blending and bulk packing systems.

blocks.title: Intake & Cleaning
desc: Bagged and bulk raw material is tipped, screened and freed of dust, foreign seed and tramp metal.
Cleaned material is conveyed to day bins so the mill runs on a steady feed.

blocks.title: Drying
desc: Wet and high-moisture material is dried before milling, because damp feed blinds screens and cakes in the mill.
Liquid extracts and slurries are dried directly into powder.

blocks.title: Size Reduction & Dust Control
desc: Dried material is pulverised to the fineness the customer specifies.
Milling runs under extraction, since fine food powders escape easily and are a housekeeping and safety issue.

blocks.title: Classification & Sieving
desc: Milled powder is separated into fine and coarse fractions, and the oversize is returned to the mill.
Sieving fixes the particle size grade the finished ingredient is sold on.

blocks.title: Blending & Standardisation
desc: Single ingredients are blended into premixes, or batches are blended together to even out natural variation.
Minor ingredients are weighed separately and pre-mixed so they disperse through the whole batch.

blocks.title: Bulk Packing & Dispatch
desc: Powder is filled into sacks, bags, drums or bulk containers and closed by sewing or sealing.
Filled units are coded, weight-checked and palletised.

h1: Eggs Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Eggs Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Eggs Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Egg processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics: shell egg washing, candling and grading, breaking and separation, pasteurising, spray drying and packing.
intro: Egg processing turns shell eggs into graded table eggs, pasteurised liquid egg and dried egg powder. Eggs are washed, candled and graded on the shell, then broken and separated into whole egg, albumen or yolk, pasteurised, and either chilled or spray dried. ART Mechatronics supplies the processing, pasteurising, drying and packing equipment for egg units.

blocks.text: Egg processing turns shell eggs into graded table eggs, pasteurised liquid egg and dried egg powder. Eggs are washed, candled and graded on the shell, then broken and separated into whole egg, albumen or yolk, pasteurised, and either chilled or spray dried. ART Mechatronics supplies the processing, pasteurising, drying and packing equipment for egg units.

blocks.title: Intake & Shell Washing
desc: Shell eggs arrive on trays and are washed with warm water and a sanitising rinse, then dried before further handling.
Washing removes soil and litter from the shell so that surface contamination is not carried into the breaking stage.

blocks.title: Candling & Grading
desc: Eggs pass over a light source for candling and are graded by weight, with cracked, leaking and stained eggs diverted off the line.
Only sound shell eggs go forward to breaking, and the rest are separated for other uses.

blocks.title: Breaking & Separation
desc: Shells are cracked and the contents are taken as whole egg or split into yolk and albumen.
The liquid is strained to remove shell fragments and membrane before it is held in buffer tanks.

blocks.title: Pasteurisation & Chilling
desc: Liquid egg is pasteurised, then cooled and held chilled until it is filled or dried.
Homogenising gives a uniform liquid for filling and for feeding the dryer.

blocks.title: Spray Drying to Egg Powder
desc: Pasteurised liquid egg is atomised into a hot air stream and dried to a free-flowing powder.
Fines are recovered from the exhaust air and the powder is sieved before storage.

blocks.title: Filling, Packing & Cold Storage
desc: Liquid egg is filled into pouches or cans and powder is filled by auger into pouches or sacks.
Packs are checked for metal, coded and labelled, then held in chilled or ambient storage as the format requires.

h1: Meat Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Meat Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Meat Line by ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Meat processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics: chilling, cutting and deboning, mincing, marination and mixing, cooking, freezing and vacuum packing.
intro: Meat processing converts chilled carcasses and primal cuts into deboned portions, mince, marinated cuts and cooked products. Meat is chilled, broken down into cuts, trimmed, minced or diced, blended with brine and seasoning, then cooked or frozen and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies cutting, mixing, cooking, freezing and packing equipment for red meat plants.

blocks.text: Meat processing converts chilled carcasses and primal cuts into deboned portions, mince, marinated cuts and cooked products. Meat is chilled, broken down into cuts, trimmed, minced or diced, blended with brine and seasoning, then cooked or frozen and packed. ART Mechatronics supplies cutting, mixing, cooking, freezing and packing equipment for red meat plants.

blocks.title: Chilling & Carcass Handling
desc: Carcasses and primals are held chilled and moved into the deboning hall on overhead and floor conveying.
Keeping the meat cold from intake onward limits microbial growth and makes cutting cleaner.

blocks.title: Cutting & Deboning
desc: Primals are broken down into cuts, boned out and trimmed of fat and connective tissue.
Trim is separated by grade so that lean and fat streams can be blended to a set recipe later.

blocks.title: Mincing & Dicing
desc: Trim and selected cuts are minced through plates or diced to the cube size the product calls for.
Particle size decides the texture of the finished mince, kebab, patty or curry cut.

blocks.title: Mixing & Marination
desc: Minced or diced meat is blended with salt, brine, spice and binders in a mixer, often under vacuum.
Vacuum mixing helps the brine take up into the meat and reduces air pockets in the batch.

blocks.title: Cooking & Cooling
desc: Cooked lines are heated in steam-jacketed kettles or cook tanks, then brought down in temperature on a cooling line.
Rapid cooling after cooking keeps the product out of the range where spoilage organisms grow quickly.

blocks.title: Freezing, Inspection & Packing
desc: Portions are frozen where required, then vacuum or thermoform packed, checked and cased.
Metal detection and checkweighing take place before cartoning so that only correct packs are dispatched.

blocks.text: Chicken processing takes dressed birds through chilling, cut-up and portioning into whole birds, fillets, drumsticks and further-processed items such as nuggets and marinated cuts. blocks.title: Chilling & Intake
desc: Dressed birds are chilled and moved into the cut-up hall on hygienic conveying.
The bird is brought down in temperature before cutting so that portions hold their shape and stay fresh.

blocks.title: Cut-Up & Portioning
desc: Whole birds are cut into breast, leg, wing and boneless fillet, and fillets are portioned to weight.
Grading by weight lets the plant build packs of similar-size pieces for retail and food service.

blocks.title: Coating & Frying

Crumb is screened and recirculated, and fried pieces are cooled before they enter the freezer.

blocks.title: IQF Freezing

Free-flowing frozen pieces let the packer weigh out any pack size from the same bulk.

blocks.title: Weighing, Packing & Inspection

blocks.text: Pork processing breaks chilled carcasses into primal cuts and converts trimmings into bacon, ham, sausage and other cured products. blocks.title: Chilling & Primal Cutting
desc: Chilled sides are broken into shoulder, loin, belly and leg on the cutting line.
Belly and loin go to bacon and ham lines, while trim is collected for sausage and emulsion products.

blocks.title: Brine Preparation & Curing
desc: Curing brine of salt, curing salt, sugar and phosphate is mixed in a jacketed tank and dosed to the cuts.
Cured cuts are held chilled so the brine distributes evenly through the muscle before cooking.

blocks.title: Mincing & Emulsifying
desc: Trim is minced, then chopped or milled with ice, salt and spice into a sausage batter or fine emulsion.
The mix is blended to a uniform batter so that fat and lean are evenly spread through the product.

blocks.title: Filling & Forming
desc: Batter is filled into casings for sausage or pressed into moulds for ham and luncheon meat.
Filled product is racked onto trolleys ready for the cook and smoke stage.

blocks.title: Cooking, Smoking & Cooling
desc: Product is cooked with steam or hot air, smoked where the recipe calls for it, then cooled.
Cooking sets the protein and colour, and cooling before slicing keeps the cut face clean.

blocks.title: Slicing & Vacuum Packing
desc: Chilled ham, bacon and sausage are sliced and laid into vacuum or thermoform packs.
Seals are leak tested and packs are labelled before chilled dispatch.

blocks.title: Receiving, Washing & Chilling
desc: Iced shrimp are tipped, washed and held in chilled water while they wait for the peeling line.
Keeping the catch cold and clean from the moment it lands protects both texture and shelf life.

blocks.title: De-heading, Peeling & Deveining
desc: Heads and shells are removed and the vein is stripped to give headless, peeled and deveined product.
Shell and head waste is taken away on a separate line so it does not mix with the edible stream.

Count size is what the buyer orders against, so grading decides where the batch is sold.

blocks.title: Blanching or Cooking

Raw lines skip this stage and go directly from grading to the freezer.

blocks.title: IQF or Block Freezing & Glazing

A water glaze is applied over frozen pieces to protect them during cold storage.

blocks.title: Weighing, Inspection & Export Packing

h1: Desiccated Coconut Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions
metaTitle: Desiccated Coconut Processing Plant | ART Mechatronics
metaDesc: Turnkey desiccated coconut processing plants from ART Mechatronics covering dehusking, paring, blanching, cutting, hot-air drying, sifting and hygienic packing.
intro: Desiccated coconut is the dried, shredded white kernel of mature coconuts, used by bakeries, confectionery makers and food processors. Production involves dehusking, shell removal, paring of the brown testa, washing, blanching, cutting to the required grade, hot-air drying and sifting. ART Mechatronics builds turnkey desiccated coconut lines covering preparation, drying, grading and hygienic packing.

blocks.text: Desiccated coconut is the dried, shredded white kernel of mature coconuts, used by bakeries, confectionery makers and food processors. Production involves dehusking, shell removal, paring of the brown testa, washing, blanching, cutting to the required grade, hot-air drying and sifting. ART Mechatronics builds turnkey desiccated coconut lines covering preparation, drying, grading and hygienic packing.

blocks.title: Dehusking & Deshelling
desc: Mature nuts are fed from reception and the fibrous husk is stripped, after which the hard shell is broken away to release the white kernel.
Husk and shell are diverted separately so that only clean kernel carries forward into the food-grade section of the plant.

blocks.title: Paring & Washing
desc: The brown testa is pared from the kernel so that the finished product stays white, and the pared kernel is then washed and rinsed.
Paring waste is collected apart from the kernel because it is normally sold on for oil extraction.

blocks.title: Blanching & Cooling
desc: Washed kernel is blanched in hot water or steam to reduce the surface microbial load before size reduction.
The kernel is then cooled on the way to the cutters so that it does not carry heat into the shredding stage.

blocks.title: Cutting to Grade
desc: Blanched kernel is disintegrated and shredded into the fine, medium or chip cut that the buyer has specified.
Cut material is screened as it leaves the cutters so that oversize pieces return for a second pass.

blocks.title: Hot Air Drying
desc: The wet shred is dried in a continuous hot-air dryer until the moisture is low enough for the product to keep in storage.
Moisture is checked on the dried stream so that the drying air can be adjusted before the batch moves on.

blocks.title: Sifting & Grading
desc: Dried shred is sifted into its commercial grades and light husk particles are drawn off in the air stream.
Graded material is held in bins so that each grade can be packed to its own specification.

blocks.title: Inspection & Packing
desc: Each grade is weighed out and formed into pouches or bags, with metal inspection ahead of the sealer.
Sealed packs are checkweighed, coded and collated into cartons for despatch.

h1: Cassava Processing Plant & Machinery Solutions

metaDesc: Cassava processing plants from ART Mechatronics covering root washing, peeling, chipping and rasping, dewatering, drying, milling, sifting and bagging.
intro: Cassava processing turns freshly harvested cassava roots into chips, flour and starch for food, feed and industrial use. The roots are washed, peeled, chipped or rasped, dewatered, dried and milled before sifting and packing. ART Mechatronics supplies complete cassava processing plants covering root handling, peeling, size reduction, drying, milling and bagging for bulk despatch.

blocks.text: Cassava processing turns freshly harvested cassava roots into chips, flour and starch for food, feed and industrial use. The roots are washed, peeled, chipped or rasped, dewatered, dried and milled before sifting and packing. ART Mechatronics supplies complete cassava processing plants covering root handling, peeling, size reduction, drying, milling and bagging for bulk despatch.

blocks.title: Reception & Root Washing
desc: Harvested roots are tipped into reception and washed to remove field soil, grit and stones picked up during lifting.
Because cassava deteriorates quickly after harvest, the intake section is sized to keep roots moving straight into peeling.

blocks.title: Peeling & Rinsing
desc: The outer rind and inner peel are removed from the root, since the peel is where most of the bitter fraction sits.
Peeled roots are rinsed again and the peel is taken away on a separate line for feed or disposal.

blocks.title: Chipping & Rasping
desc: Peeled roots are cut into chips for the drying line, or rasped and crushed to a mash where starch is the end product.
Reducing the root soon after peeling limits discolouration and gives the dryer an even feed.

blocks.title: Dewatering
desc: Wet mash is pressed so that free water is taken out mechanically rather than driven off in the dryer.
The pressed cake is broken up before it is fed forward so that it dries evenly.

blocks.title: Drying
desc: Chips or pressed cake are dried in a flash or rotary dryer until the moisture is low enough for milling and storage.
Dried material is separated from the drying air in a cyclone before it goes to the mill.

blocks.title: Milling & Sifting
desc: Dried cassava is milled into flour or starch powder and sifted so that oversize particles are returned to the mill.
Milling is run under dust extraction because cassava powder is light and carries readily into the plant air.

blocks.title: Bagging & Despatch
desc: Flour, starch or dried chips are weighed into sacks, stitched and checkweighed for bulk despatch.
Bagged output is palletised and wrapped for transport.

intro: Copra is the dried kernel of the mature coconut and the main raw material for coconut oil milling. Coconuts are dehusked and split, the kernel is dried in kilns or hot-air dryers until the moisture is stable, then scooped from the shell, cleaned and graded. blocks.text: Copra is the dried kernel of the mature coconut and the main raw material for coconut oil milling. Coconuts are dehusked and split, the kernel is dried in kilns or hot-air dryers until the moisture is stable, then scooped from the shell, cleaned and graded. ART Mechatronics supplies copra drying, deshelling, grading and bulk handling plants.

blocks.title: Dehusking & Splitting
desc: Mature nuts are dehusked and then split so that the nut water drains away and both halves can be dried in shell.
Split nuts are carried cup upwards to the dryer so that the kernel does not fall out in transit.

blocks.title: Kiln Drying
desc: Split nuts are dried with indirect hot air in place of open smoke drying, which keeps soot and smoke taint off the kernel.
Trays or batches are rotated through the dryer so that drying is even across the load.

blocks.title: Cup Scooping & Shell Removal
desc: Part-dried kernel shrinks away from the shell and is scooped out as cup copra, with the shell separated for charcoal or fuel.
Shell fragments are removed from the copra stream before the second drying pass.

blocks.title: Finish Drying
desc: Scooped copra is given a second drying pass so that moisture is brought down to a level at which it can be stored without mould.
Moisture is checked on the finished copra before it is released to the grading line.

blocks.title: Cleaning & Grading
desc: Dried copra is cleaned of dust, fibre and shell, then graded by size and colour, with discoloured or mouldy pieces taken out.
Grading matters because oil millers buy copra against colour and moisture.

blocks.title: Bulk Storage & Bagging
desc: Graded copra is elevated into silos or bins for holding, then drawn off for bagging as orders are made up.
Sacks are stitched, checkweighed and palletised for despatch to the oil mill.

blocks.title: Dehusking & Deshelling

blocks.title: Paring & Cutting to Size

blocks.title: Drying

blocks.title: Sorting & Grading

Fines and broken pieces are screened off and sold as a separate grade.

blocks.title: Packing

Packs pass metal inspection and are cartoned for retail or bulk despatch.

blocks.title: Kernel Preparation
desc: Nuts are dehusked and deshelled and the brown testa is pared away, because testa colour carries straight through into the cream.
Pared kernel is washed and rinsed before it goes to extraction.

blocks.title: Comminution & Wet Extraction
desc: Kernel is disintegrated and wet ground into a fine slurry, then pressed so that the milk is separated from the residue.
Press residue is taken off for drying or feed use rather than being returned to the milk line.

blocks.title: Separation & Standardising
desc: The extract is separated to take out fibre and fines, then blended in stirred tanks so that fat and solids are brought to the declared recipe.
Cream and thinner milk fractions are held apart so that different pack specifications can be made from one extraction.

blocks.title: Homogenising & Heat Treatment
desc: The standardised emulsion is homogenised so that the fat is dispersed evenly through the milk rather than sitting as a separate layer.
It is then pasteurised or sterilised according to whether the product is chilled or ambient.

blocks.title: Chilling & Holding
desc: Chilled product is cooled and held under refrigeration until it is filled.
Holding tanks are kept agitated so that the emulsion does not stratify before filling.

blocks.title: Filling & Packing
desc: Product is filled into cans, retort pouches or bottles, then seamed or sealed and coded.
Filled packs are labelled and case packed for despatch.

sections.title: Complete Activated Charcoal Water Process Flow

blocks.title: Shell Intake & Carbonisation
desc: Coconut shell is separated from residual kernel and fibre, then carbonised in a closed kiln so that volatiles are driven off and charcoal remains.
The plant is laid out so that carbonisation off-gas is taken to the emission control section rather than released.

blocks.title: Crushing & Sizing
desc: Charcoal is crushed and screened into the particle bands the activation stage needs, since granular and powdered grades start from different feed sizes.
Undersize fines are collected separately for the powdered grade instead of going into the activation feed.

blocks.title: Steam Activation
desc: Sized charcoal is heated in the activation furnace and steam is injected, which opens the pore structure that gives the carbon its adsorption capacity.
Steam supply and furnace heating are run from the utility section serving the activation line.

blocks.title: Cooling & Emission Control
desc: Activated carbon is cooled after discharge, and the flue and process gases pass through scrubbing and dust collection before venting.
Emission control equipment is treated as part of the process line, not an afterthought, because carbonisation and activation both generate gas and dust.

blocks.title: Milling & Grading
desc: Cooled carbon is milled and classified into granular and powdered grades against the mesh specification ordered.
Off-spec material is returned to the mill rather than blended into the graded product.

blocks.title: De-dusting, Bagging & Despatch
desc: Graded carbon is de-dusted so that loose fines do not travel with the pack, then filled into sacks, drums or bulk bags.
Filled packs are weighed, sealed and palletised, with the packing hall kept under dust extraction.

intro: Tablet manufacturing compresses blended powders and granules into uniform solid doses. ART Mechatronics supplies tablet plant machinery covering granulation, drying, blending, coating, inspection and packaging lines for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers.

blocks.text: Tablet manufacturing compresses blended powders and granules into uniform solid doses. Ingredients are sifted, mixed, granulated and dried, then compressed, de-dusted and often film or sugar coated before strip, blister or bottle packing. blocks.title: Sifting & Milling
desc: Actives and excipients are screened to a common particle size and de-lumped so the blend behaves consistently.
Tramp metal is pulled out before the powder enters the granulator.

blocks.title: Wet Granulation
desc: Binder solution is added to the sifted powder and worked into granules, which flow and compress better than loose powder.
Granule size is brought down to a workable range before drying.

blocks.title: Drying & Sizing
desc: Wet granules are dried, then passed through a screen to break down oversized lumps.
Moisture is measured on the dried granules before blending.

blocks.title: Blending & Lubrication
desc: Dried granules are blended with disintegrants, glidants and lubricant so the mass releases cleanly from the press tooling.
Tumbling blenders are used because they mix without shearing the granules.

blocks.title: Compression & De-Dusting
desc: The lubricated blend is compressed into tablets, which carry loose powder on the surface and edges as they leave the press.
Tablets are de-dusted, extracted air is collected, and the stream is screened for metal before coating.

blocks.title: Coating
desc: Cores are film or sugar coated in a rotating pan to mask taste, protect the active or carry a delayed release.
Warm filtered air is supplied to the pan and the coated tablets are dried in the same drum.

blocks.title: Strip, Blister & Carton Packing
desc: Finished tablets are sealed into strips or thermoformed blisters, then collated into unit cartons with the leaflet.
Each pack is weight-checked and coded before it goes into the shipper.
